## Acceptance and procedure
State expected outcomes, tolerances, exact commands, and failure/stop conditions.

## Observed results
Retain immutable stdout/stderr/artifacts, exit codes and measured observations.

## Limits and follow-up

A software/synthetic pass leaves physical, safety and gate criteria pending.
